capabilities: Filter D&D 5e spells by name, level, and class
Search via a tag system or three standalone input fields
Open the spell picker from the ribbon icon or a command
disambiguation: Not a spellcheck or spelling tool; it browses D&D 5e magic spells.
extras: A separate web-based version exists; the README asks for accuracy complaints to go to the D&D 5e SRD API maintainers and links a Ko-fi for donations.
motivation: Picking spells is difficult given how many options there are and how they interact, so the author wanted to streamline the process.
problem: Picking spells for a character means jumping between wiki tabs or book pages, with no single searchable list.

relations.evidence: The app uses D&D 5e SRD API for all it's data.

summary: D&D 5e spell browser that filters all basic spells by name, level, and class for character building.
